title: AI request / reply
description: Shape of the data payload returned by `cos ai chat|embed|image-generate`. Apps call this via SDK helpers (claw_os_sdk.ai.chat / ai.embed / ai.image_generate). The kernel emits the same fields whether the call was synchronous or streamed (terminating reply).

verb.description: Which AI verb produced this reply.

embedding.description: Single embedding vector (ai.embed). For batch input, kernel returns an array of arrays under `embeddings`.

output_path.description: Filesystem path where the kernel wrote the generated artifact (image generation).

usage.description: Token / unit accounting for this single call.

units.description: Provider-agnostic cost units, billed against the app budget.

budget.description: Snapshot of the app's budget *after* this call.

tool_calls.description: Catalog tool invocations the model requested in this turn. Each entry includes name, args, result (if executed kernel-side).

raw.description: Provider-native response object, included only when env var COS_AI_RAW=1.
